faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Junior Lab/Field Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the PAU Junior Lab/Field Helper position is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Middle school education and possess knowledge of Punjabi to be eligible for the Junior Lab/Field Helper position at PAU.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Lab/Field Helper role?
faq.answer: The age limit for this recruitment is between 18 years and 63 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for PAU Junior Lab/Field Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories (General/OBC, SC/ST) is Rs. 50/-. This fee is payable as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Lab/Field Helper position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Lab/Field Helper post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 10,870.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Lab/Field Helper position involves an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Junior Lab/Field Helper position at Punjab Agricultural University is a contractual job. Details regarding the contract duration are available in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, which is www.pau.edu.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with your application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the walk-in date for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview for the Junior Lab/Field Helper position is scheduled to be held on 09th September 2026.
